messages:
maya: Quick design sync — attaching new mock for SLO snapshots + pool fallback CTA. Thoughts? https://figma.com/proto/... :eyes:
kevin: Love the SLO snapshot chip idea but worried about visual weight. Suggest reducing shadow and using 14px label.
olivia: Agreed on weight. Also accessibility: snapshot chip needs keyboard focus ring and aria-label 'SLO snapshot {name}, applied'.
sam: Where does pool fallback live? The mock shows a 'Fallback to smaller GPU pool' CTA under the SLO slider — feels like an action without guardrail. Maybe require confirmation.
maya: Good point. Thinking: if user picks aggressive SLO but capacity low, show a non-dismissable banner + 'Apply fallback' button with tooltip explaining cost tradeoffs.
aiden: @kevin can you try two microcopy options? One concise, one more explanatory.
kevin: Sure. Option A: 'Enable automatic pool fallback'
Option B: 'Automatically route traffic to a compatible GPU pool when capacity is limited (may change cost/latency)'. Which flows better?
olivia: Option B is clearer but long. Maybe: 'Automatically fall back to compatible pools — may increase latency/cost'.
sam: From product: need a 'preview' step showing estimated latency & cost delta before enabling. That's higher priority than exact copy.
maya: Agree. Also UX nit: the min/max steppers currently reset when you open the burst modal. Could we persist draft changes? Users lose work.
kevin: Persisting drafts lgtm. Implementation note: store to local draft key per-pool: `autoscale:draft:{poolId}`
ui-bot: deploy-bot: design snapshot uploaded — snapshot id 9876. Preview link https://...
aiden: Accessibility nit: min/max inputs need labels for screen readers and explicit stepper aria-live announcing changes.
olivia: Also color contrast for SLO slider thumb fails AA at small widths. Need darker tone or larger track.
maya: :thumbsup: I'll update the figma with Option B trimmed + add preview modal and draft persistence state. Can we mock the preview numbers using synthetic workload samples?
sam: Yes, use `workload-sim:v2` in the preview — put a small 'sample used' line so users know it's simulated.
kevin: I'll send a small PR for the copy + aria attrs after figma update.
maya: Thanks all. Sync tomorrow 10am to review updated mock. If anyone has strong opinions before then drop them here.
